name: Ayasegawa Vega
source:
The daughter part of the mother-daughter pair who moved in next to the protagonist's room. She is a female student who is unsociable and hard to approach, but actually she's got another personality......?

She's at the age where she's curious about sex, so she aggressively seduces Susumu. Has normal size breasts.
